Name: Combo Timer (Wayne)
Punchline: Native combo timer with continuous Viper enhancement duration.
Description: Shows the Simple Tweaks-style HUD countdown. In PvE on Viper, continuously shows the remaining Honed Steel or Honed Reavers duration through all combo steps, including while the starter's highlight is hidden. Use /waynecombo for settings.
